status: SPECIFIED; NOT_RUN (dependencies and downloads not approved; also gated on P3-REAL-01R readouts)

task.name: wedding-topic steering (benign)
task.label: lexicon hits in the generated continuation only (prompt text excluded); success = at least one hit; rate = hits per word
task.lexicon_source: Turner et al., Activation Addition (arXiv:2308.10248), App. H keyword list (checked in source text)
task.label_independence: the label never uses the SAE; the SAE is used only to choose the steered feature on calibration data
task.label_scope: lexical proxy only; semantic success is NOT_RUN unless an independent semantic evaluation (validated against humans) is added

data.prompts: windows (BOS + 127 tokens) whose decoded text has zero lexicon hits; prompt = BOS + first 31 tokens; at most 4 windows per document chosen with a seeded RNG

calibration_only_choices.feature: argmax over SAE features of mean activation on tokens of calibration windows with >= 1 lexicon hit minus mean activation on tokens of windows with 0 hits; top-5 recorded for sensitivity but not used
calibration_only_choices.diffmean_vector: mean centred hook activation over tokens of hit windows minus mean over tokens of no-hit windows (calibration)
calibration_only_choices.norm_budget_grid: multipliers (norm_budget_multipliers) of the calibration median centred residual norm
calibration_only_choices.matched_quality_rule: for each method, the largest budget whose mean KL(P_clean || P_edited) on calibration prompts (edit at all positions) is <= kappa

methods.encoder_grad: rho * W_enc[:, j] / ||W_enc[:, j]|| at every position
methods.jacobian_ln: per position t: least-norm direction M_t^+ e_1 (M_t = encoder rows of j and of features active at t), scaled to rho
methods.diffmean: rho * v / ||v|| (calibration DiffMean), the simplest non-SAE baseline
not_run_baselines: FGAA (require a fitted effect model from many steering runs)
methods.mean_only: rho * 1/sqrt(d): model-invisible negative control (expected: no change in lexical success or KL)
methods.projection: decoder, encoder_grad, diffmean and random directions are projected by P before scaling

quality: KL(P_clean || P_edited) averaged over prompt positions
NLL of the generated continuation under the unedited model (fluency proxy)
internal_secondary: NOT IMPLEMENTED in adapter v1 (planned: SAE re-encoded target change and non-target drift at prompt positions; never used as the label)

primary_comparison: per test document, success at each method's calibration-selected budget: jacobian_ln - decoder, jacobian_ln - diffmean, decoder - diffmean; document-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals. Also full success-vs-KL and success-vs-norm curves.
interpretation_rule: The method claim is supported only if jacobian_ln beats decoder, encoder_grad and diffmean on held-out success at matched calibration KL with intervals excluding 0. Anything else (including internal-metric-only gains) is reported as not supported.
changelog: v2 (third session, before any REAL-02 run): all directions projected onto admissible edits (P = I - 11^T/d; P3-CONTRACT-EXEC K9); LN uses J_E P; mean_only negative control added; float64 per contract v2; label restricted to a lexical proxy; semantic success NOT_RUN without an independent semantic evaluation.
